title: ctier outcome record
description: What happened when an approved Tier 3 executed. The only record that proves C6 held. Written after the fact by definition. This format reaches 1.0.0 when an implementation other than the reference one has been held to records in it. Until then it is normative — it defines what an Outcome is — but it has only ever been read by its author, which is a weaker claim than stability.
